notes.title: Bug fixes: v1.41.1
notes.content:
- Updated some localized strings
- Updated credits
- Bugfix: hint mode can make some atoms remain faded when a solution is made
- Bugfix: hint mode can make some atoms to not fade if when they are on top of a hint
- Bugfix: can't delete the last segment of track going into the destination tile by dragging from the track onto destination
- Pi-2 updated
- Pi-5 updated
- Small change to build track input: when building track diagonally game will always try to make the shortest distance track and when removing track sideways it will remove track regardless of length
